snippets.name: Custom order email notice
snippets.desc: Adds a short custom message to WooCommerce customer order emails (by default only the "Processing order" email) — e.g. a temporary dispatch-delay announcement. Understated styling (optional heading + text, thin rule, no coloured box), with optional per-language text for multilingual stores. Empty by default: nothing is added to any email until you fill in the message.
